title: Base64 from RFC 4648
description:
Implement Base64 by reading the RFC, and check it with the RFC's own test vectors.

```
""       -> ""
"f"      -> "Zg=="
"fo"     -> "Zm8="
"foo"    -> "Zm9v"
"foobar" -> "Zm9vYmFy"
all 7 test vectors pass, decode(encode(x)) == x
```
hints: Take 24 bits as `b0 << 16 | b1 << 8 | b2` and split them into four 6-bit indexes (lesson 4.04).
requirements: Encode 3 bytes into 4 characters from the alphabet in section 4, padding with `=`.
Decode back, refusing characters outside the alphabet.
Use the test vectors in section 10.
stretch: Add the URL-safe alphabet from section 5.
